line: Your allies show up today. Ask for backup; you don't have to carry it alone.
A friendly contest today. Let them win the small one; you'll take the next.
You read the room fast today. Trust it, but check the facts before you act.
Help arrives quietly today. Accept the lift home and say thanks properly.
The to-do list grows legs today. Pick three; the rest can wait.
Your effort gets seen today. Show the work; let others do the praising.
A good deal crosses your path today. If it's a big one, sleep on it.
Friday treat time. Set the budget first, then enjoy every bite.
Weekend mood starts early today. Plan something fun that fits the budget.
You'll say what everyone is thinking today. Pick kind words; the timing's good.
